explanation: By the block bound, if S_B <= eps and S_W <= eps with (1+eps)^{l+1} <= 3/2 (eps = 1/(4(l+1)), one_add_pow_le) then dualMassE <= 1/2; so a bad pair has a bad B or a bad W. Markov over uniform B (resp. W) with the counting of SigabaNeoStd's sum_dualMassE_le (card_orth_le, for any n, m and prime q) bounds the bad B by q^{nm}(S1 + q^{n-m} S2)/eps and the bad W by q^{lnm}(S1 + q^{ln-m} S2)/eps, with S1 = sum over nonzero u of exp(-pi tau^2|u|^2) <= 6 m exp(-pi tau^2) and S2 = sum of exp(-pi tau^2|v|^2/q^2) <= (4q/tau)^m (the estimates of Trapdoor.Family.wt1_bound and wt_bound with the parameters as hypotheses).
